candidates.in_scope: Optional score_provenance field on rows; LoadScores accepts {module: {score, provenance}} extended shape (back-compat with flat).
candidates.done_condition: Rows carry provenance when supplied; flat maps still work.
candidates.current_state: The version-everything spine is shipped (internal/modver + fak version modules + the fak-module-versions/1 ledger seeded with 410 modules); this unit does not exist yet.
candidates.working_spine: internal/modver (Snapshot/DeltaRows/JoinScores, Runner seam) and the fak version modules shell (cmd/fak/version_modules.go) are the working base to extend; docs/notes/VERSION-EVERYTHING-SPINE-2026-07-03.md is the doctrine.
candidates.out_of_scope: Everything not named in in_scope; other modver-* children; non-additive changes to the fak-module-versions/1 schema (a breaking row change is a /2 with its own contract).
candidates.acceptance_gate: make ci green including the named witness test; fak commit --preview clean with the lane (fak <leaf>) stamp before committing.
candidates.closure_binding: Closed only by a ship commit whose body carries 'Closes #<this issue>' and whose diff lands the named witness in the same commit; a bare (#N) subject reference is a mention, not a close.

candidates.in_scope: Optional @rev suffix convention in CLAIMS.md lines + a claims-lint advisory comparing cited vs live rev.
candidates.done_condition: Lint flags an aged fixture claim.

candidates.title: modver: opt-in declared semver overlay for modules that graduate to contracts
candidates.why_now: Derived rev is the default for all 410 modules, but a handful (abi, policy schema, ledger schemas) carry real compatibility contracts where MAJOR.MINOR semantics matter; those deserve an opt-in declared overlay reconciled against the derived rev.
candidates.in_scope: A small declared map (module -> semver) validated at test time against derived history (a declared bump must coincide with real movement); render as v1.2.0+r47.
candidates.done_condition: Overlay renders for one graduated module with validation test.
